name: cta-button
title: CTA Button
description: Call-to-action buttons with a shimmer sweep, spinning gradient border, magnetic pull or sliding arrow.

name: expanding-button
title: Expanding Button
description: A compact button that springs open into an inline panel of actions or a small form, then folds back.

name: icon-swap
title: Icon Swap
description: Button that morphs between icon states — copy to check, play to pause — with an optional particle burst.

name: spring-button
title: Spring Button
description: A button with springy hover/press physics and a morphing loading state.

name: theme-toggle
title: Theme Toggle
description: A sun/moon toggle with a rotating swap animation.

name: color-picker
title: Color Picker
description: HSV color picker with springy thumbs, hex/RGB/HSL fields, eyedropper, recents and a popover variant.

name: color-swatches
title: Color Swatches
description: Color picker where a springy ring hops between swatches, with an optional custom color.

name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Searchable select whose options glide in and out as you type, with the matched text highlighted.

name: date-range-picker
title: Date Range Picker
description: A calendar popover with presets, a range band that stretches between dates and sliding months.

name: dial-picker
title: Dial Picker
description: A circular dial: drag the knob around a ticked arc, it snaps to steps while the readout rolls.

name: floating-input
title: Floating Input
description: Text field whose label springs up on focus, with an animated focus ring, clear button and sliding error.

name: motion-select
title: Motion Select
description: Single-select dropdown that scales out of its trigger, with a gliding highlight and drawn-in check.

name: multi-select
title: Multi Select
description: Pick many options: choices pop into the field as chips and reflow with layout animation.

name: otp-input
title: OTP Input
description: One-time-code input with popping digits, a blinking caret and an error shake.

name: radio-cards
title: Radio Cards
description: Radio group where the selection ring and dot spring between options, as cards or a compact list.

name: range-slider
title: Range Slider
description: Single or dual-thumb slider with growing thumbs, a value bubble that follows, and an animated fill.

name: spring-checkbox
title: Spring Checkbox
description: Checkbox that squishes on press and draws its check mark in, with an indeterminate state.

name: spring-switch
title: Spring Switch
description: A toggle whose thumb springs across and stretches while pressed.

name: wheel-picker
title: Wheel Picker
description: An iOS-style 3D scroll wheel with flick momentum that snaps to items; combine wheels for time pickers.

name: animated-tooltip
title: Animated Tooltip
description: A lightweight tooltip that springs out from any side with a blur-in.

name: bottom-sheet
title: Bottom Sheet
description: A mobile-style sheet with snap points, velocity-aware dragging and a background that scales back.

name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: A right-click / long-press menu with a gliding highlight, shortcuts and a submenu that slides out.

name: expanding-modal
title: Expanding Modal
description: A modal that grows out of the exact button that opened it and collapses back into it.

name: morphing-dialog
title: Morphing Dialog
description: A card that morphs into a full dialog using a shared layout transition.

name: spring-drawer
title: Spring Drawer
description: A side drawer that springs in from any edge, with a drag-to-dismiss handle and focus trap.

name: spring-popover
title: Spring Popover
description: A click-to-open popover that springs out of its trigger, with an arrow and smart flipping.

name: animated-tabs
title: Animated Tabs
description: Tabs with a shared-layout indicator that glides between triggers.

name: breadcrumbs
title: Breadcrumbs
description: A breadcrumb trail that staggers in, underlines the current page and springs open collapsed levels.

name: dock
title: Dock
description: A magnifying dock where icons grow as the pointer approaches.

name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Page buttons with a sliding active pill, smart ellipses and numbers that roll with the direction.

name: spring-sidebar
title: Spring Sidebar
description: An app sidebar that springs between full width and an icon rail, with a gliding active indicator.

name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Multi-step progress with spring-filled connectors, steps that morph into checks and a pulsing current step.

name: aspect-ratio
title: Aspect Ratio
description: A fluid box that holds a ratio and springs smoothly to a new shape when the ratio changes.

name: aurora-background
title: Aurora Background
description: A section backdrop of soft, slowly drifting gradient blobs with optional film grain; transform-only and light on CPU.

name: bouncy-accordion
title: Bouncy Accordion
description: Accordion panels that open with a bouncy height spring and blur-in content.

name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: A single disclosure whose content springs open to its natural height and blurs into focus.

name: hover-highlight
title: Hover Highlight
description: List, nav or grid where one shared background glides to the hovered item and fades out on leave.

name: orbit-carousel
title: Orbit Carousel
description: Cards on a 3D ring: drag to spin with inertia that snaps to the nearest card, or let it orbit slowly.

name: spotlight-card
title: Spotlight Card
description: A card lit by a soft spotlight and glowing rim that follow the pointer, with a gentle hover lift.

name: tilt-card
title: Tilt Card
description: A 3D card that tilts toward the pointer with a moving glare.

name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: Seamless infinite scroller in any direction that eases to a stop on hover, with faded edges.

name: number-ticker
title: Number Ticker
description: Counts up to a value with spring physics when scrolled into view.

name: scroll-reveal
title: Scroll Reveal
description: Reveals children with staggered presets as they scroll into view, plus a springy reading progress bar.

name: text-reveal
title: Text Reveal
description: Staggered word or character reveal with blur and lift.

name: alert
title: Alert
description: Inline alert whose icon pops and draws itself in, with a dismiss that smoothly collapses its height.

name: loader
title: Loader
description: Five loaders — wave, orbit, bars, ring and a typing skeleton — that calm down for reduced motion.

name: pull-to-refresh
title: Pull to Refresh
description: Pull a scroll area down with rubber-band resistance; a spinning indicator holds while your refresh runs.

name: toast-stack
title: Toast Stack
description: Stacked notifications that fan out on hover, with a tiny imperative API.

name: avatar-group
title: Avatar Group
description: Overlapping avatars that spread apart on hover with springy name tags.

name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: A sortable, selectable table whose rows glide into their new order and whose selection bar slides up.

name: file-tree
title: File Tree
description: A keyboard-navigable file tree whose folders spring open and whose selection glides between rows.

name: filmstrip
title: Filmstrip
description: A gallery preview with a draggable thumbnail rail; a frame glides to the active shot as images slide in.

name: lightbox
title: Lightbox
description: An image grid whose thumbnails morph into a full-screen viewer you can swipe through or drag away.

name: motion-badge
title: Motion Badge
description: Badge with odometer-style rolling counts and an optional pulsing live dot.

name: sortable-list
title: Sortable List
description: A drag-to-reorder list where rows lift off the page and the rest glide aside; keyboard friendly.

name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: A vertical timeline whose line draws in as you scroll while each event pops and slides into place.

name: action-bar
title: Action Bar
description: A floating bulk-action bar that springs in on selection, rolls its count and confirms in place.

name: command-palette
title: Command Palette
description: A ⌘K palette with fuzzy search, a gliding selection, nested pages that slide in and shortcuts.

name: dynamic-island
title: Dynamic Island
description: A pill that springs its width, height and radius between live states while the content cross-fades.

name: expandable-tabs
title: Expandable Tabs
description: An icon-only tab bar where the active tab springs open to reveal its label with a blur-in.

name: fluid-tabs
title: Fluid Tabs
description: Tabs whose indicator stretches like liquid between triggers while panels slide and resize.

name: morphing-search
title: Morphing Search
description: A search icon that springs open into a field, with recent searches and suggestions that stagger in.

name: overflow-toolbar
title: Overflow Toolbar
description: A toolbar that measures its width and springs the actions that don't fit into a “more” menu.

name: agent-activity
title: Agent Activity
description: Live feed of an agent's steps: new steps slide in, the current one shimmers, sub-steps fold away.

name: approval-card
title: Approval Card
description: Asks the user to approve an agent action, then collapses into a compact resolved row with a stamp that slams in.

name: chat-app
title: Chat App
description: A complete AI chat: header, welcome screen with suggestions, streaming messages and a prompt composer.

name: chat-message
title: Chat Message
description: A chat message with avatar, streaming caret and copy, retry and feedback actions that fade in on hover.

name: chat-scroller
title: Chat Scroller
description: A conversation viewport that sticks to the latest message, springs in a jump pill and keeps its place on prepend.

name: citations
title: Citations
description: Numbered citation chips with hover cards, linked to a sources list that lights up the cited source.

name: code-block
title: Code Block
description: Code with a file header, line numbers, highlighted lines, a copy-to-check button and a springy collapse for long snippets.

name: conversation-sidebar
title: Conversation Sidebar
description: Chat history grouped by date, with search, a gliding active marker, inline rename and an icon rail.

name: file-diff
title: File Diff
description: A unified diff viewer with a change bar, folding unchanged lines and per-hunk accept or reject that springs shut.

name: image-generation
title: Image Generation
description: Image placeholder where grainy colour fields sharpen behind a scan line, then the result fades in.

name: model-picker
title: Model Picker
description: Compact AI model dropdown with capability badges, typeahead and a check mark that glides to your pick.

name: prompt-input
title: Prompt Input
description: An AI composer with an auto-growing textarea, pop-in attachment chips and a send button that morphs into stop.

name: streaming-text
title: Streaming Text
description: Streamed AI answers where each new chunk blurs in, with a blinking cursor and light Markdown.

name: suggestion-chips
title: Suggestion Chips
description: Prompt suggestions that stagger in, lift on hover, fly into your input on click and reshuffle.

name: task-list
title: Task List
description: An agent's plan with a live progress bar, spinning active step, drawn checkmarks and a strike that sweeps across.

name: thinking-indicator
title: Thinking Indicator
description: AI loading states: wave dots, shimmering text, a pulsing orb, a scan bar and a collapsible reasoning panel.

name: tool-call
title: Tool Call
description: A collapsible card for a tool invocation with a live status indicator, timer and pretty-printed arguments and result.

name: voice-orb
title: Voice Orb
description: A living orb for voice assistants that deforms with the audio level as it listens, thinks and speaks.

name: bar-chart
title: Bar Chart
description: Grouped, stacked or horizontal bars that spring up in a stagger and glide between layouts.

name: bump-chart
title: Bump Chart
description: Rankings over time as curved lanes that draw in; hover one to bring it forward and dim the rest.

name: donut-chart
title: Donut Chart
description: Rounded ring segments that sweep in; hovering one swells it and counts its value up in the centre.

name: funnel-chart
title: Funnel Chart
description: Conversion funnel whose stages spring open in sequence, joined by curved hand-offs with drop-off rates.

name: heat-calendar
title: Heat Calendar
description: A year of daily activity as a weeks × weekdays grid that ripples in; drag across days to select a range.

name: line-chart
title: Line Chart
description: Multi-series line or area chart that draws in, morphs on new data and tracks a snapping crosshair.

name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A tiny trend line that draws itself in, with a smooth monotone curve.

name: status-history
title: Status History
description: Uptime bars per day that rise in a wave, coloured by status, with an overall uptime readout.

name: treemap
title: Treemap
description: Squarified treemap whose tiles glide to their new size and position whenever the data changes.

name: chart-utils
title: Chart Utils
description: Shared chart helpers: nice ticks, scales, monotone paths, tweened values and a clamped tooltip.
